rows.why_long: PrizePicks lower 17.0 needs 57% per pick for your entry; fair view 74% (draftkings 13.5, moved to this line). Averaging 19.2 over the last 8 games, lower than 17.0 in 36% of them (raw 40%, shrunk 67%). Projects 18.4 (raw 44%, shrunk 72%).
why_points: The pick: Carries lower 17.0 on PrizePicks. Each pick has to win 57% of the time for a typical entry to make money; the sportsbooks' fair view (draftkings 13.5, moved to this line) is 74%.
Other apps: Underdog 16.5. This is the best number for the lower side.
Game log, most recent first: 15, 19, 21, 23, 26, 16, 24, 9. Weighted average 19.2; went lower than 17.0 in 3 of 8 games (36% recency-weighted).
How much he swings: game to game he typically moves about ±4.8, so the line is 0.5 of those swings below his average (standard deviations) — a modest gap.
Projection: we expect 18.4 carries on average; in a typical game 16.9 (a few big games pull the average up, so the typical game is what we compare with the line) — 0.1 below the line.

Keeping it honest: on their own, recent games (form) say 40% and the matchup 44%. The sportsbooks are usually close to right, and these methods have only partly beaten them (weights measured on NFL week 2), so we pull them most of the way toward the market: form 67%, matchup 72%.
Bottom line: we give it 72% to win and it needs 57%. The edge is the difference: +14.8 points; that works out to about +26¢ per $1 bet over the long run.
